items.title: Georg Brunis Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: And if the Kaiser would have won that war, we'd have been very wealthy people.

ctx.x: Belgium, well that's practically French too, isn't it? I never did know for sure.
My grandfather was born in Lipschick, Germany. And if the Kaiser would have won that war, we'd have been very wealthy people. Which I'm glad he didn't.
Yeah, was their name Brunis or another?
